The '''Duelist vibrorapier''' was an elegant and expensive [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibro]][[Vibrorapier/Legends|rapier]] marketed by [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]] to the upper classes, [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], and gentry of the galaxy. Many such weapons were appropriated from their owners by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]]. The Duelist vibrorapier was notable for its silence, as most vibroblades emitted a sharp, high-pitched whine. The rapier shifted its sound signature into the ultrasonic range, making it inaudible to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] races.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Instant Adventures]] the weapon is '''mistakenly''' listed as "[[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]]" and has a damage stat too low to be a [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|Vibroweapon]].
